description: inline de-DE <regexp> rules with case conversion in language locale

args.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="de">
<category id="CAT" name="Category">
<rule id="DE0" name="n"><regexp>(straße)</regexp><message>m <suggestion><match no="1" case_conversion="startupper"/></suggestion></message></rule>
<rule id="DE1" name="n"><regexp>(ärzte?)</regexp><message>m <suggestion><match no="1" case_conversion="allupper"/></suggestion></message></rule>
<rule id="DE2" name="n"><regexp>(ich) (bin)</regexp><message>m <suggestion>\2 \1</suggestion></message></rule>
</category>
</rules>
texts: Ich bin hier. ich bin da
